items.title: M3: implement pack cache with freshness-safe invalidation
items.context: Add a derived MemoryFreshnessPack cache keyed by schemaVersion, consumer, normalized query/context, contributing source digest tuple, runtime config digest, consumer policy version, top-k/line cap, and indexVersion. Preserve authority=non_authoritative and gateEvidence=false. Related plan section: playbook-memory-entry-layer-optimization-plan.md M3.

happy.desc: unchanged inputs produce a cache hit and identical bounded pack digest

edge.desc: stale-irrelevant broad source changes do not create a hard hot-path miss when contributing rows are unchanged

adversarial.desc: changed contributing rows, policy, limits, or indexVersion miss/invalidate the cache and never make memory gate evidence

items.userSees: A smoke transcript shows cacheHit/cacheMiss behavior and confirms the rendered memory pack still says authority=non_authoritative and gateEvidence=false.

verificationEvidence.note: M3-M6 smoke PASS: unchanged requests hit the cache and preserve identical bounded pack digest; build also passed with npm --prefix packages/main run build.
M3-M6 smoke PASS: stale-irrelevant broad source changes are treated as soft cache hits when contributing rows are unchanged.
M3-M6 smoke PASS: contributing source changes miss/invalidate cache; stale-irrelevant freshness changes recompute packDigest; authority remains non_authoritative and gateEvidence=false.

items.title: M4: roll indexed/cached memory packs into lifecycle consumers
items.context: Wire the optimized indexed/cached MemoryFreshnessPack path into session_brief, handoff create/resume, story intake/story advance, DONE prepare/closure, and final response check. Every consumer remains advisory-only with authority=non_authoritative and gateEvidence=false.

happy.desc: session_brief and handoff consumers show optimized indexed/cached packs with stable digest, visible relevant lessons, and non-authoritative metadata

edge.desc: story intake/story advance and DONE/final-response consumers use the optimized path without relying on memory as proof

adversarial.desc: consumer policy cannot turn memory pack text into review, validation, DONE, or release evidence

items.userSees: Running session_brief/handoff/story/DONE/final-response checks shows the same bounded Memory Runtime Preflight block using the optimized path, with lessons visible and gateEvidence=false.

verificationEvidence.note: M3-M6 smoke PASS: session_brief, host_handoff, story_create, done_prepare, done_closure, and final_response_check consumers share optimized cached packs with stable digest and non-authoritative metadata.

items.title: M5: add reference-versus-optimized correctness matrix
items.context: For both reference and optimized paths verify active playbook surfacing, candidate false-surface zero, superseded suppression, stale-relevant/stale-irrelevant behavior, deprecated brand residue classification, malformed-row resilience, and line-cap/omittedCount preservation.

happy.desc: optimized path matches reference path for active playbook and required ids on matrix fixtures

edge.desc: superseded, stale-irrelevant, stale-relevant, and line-cap behavior match reference semantics

adversarial.desc: candidate playbooks, deprecated brand residue, and malformed rows do not surface as current guidance or crash either path

items.userSees: The M3-M6 smoke prints a correctness matrix where active, candidate, superseded, stale, deprecated, malformed, and line-cap cases all show PASS for reference and optimized paths.

items.title: M6: prove million-record indexed/cached parity with report-first latency
items.context: Generate or reuse deterministic 1,000,000-record baseline; run reference full-scan, indexed runtime, and cached runtime gold queries; compare required IDs, freshness, false-surface, supersession, deprecated-term, malformed-row, maxLines, and omittedCount; report reference/indexed-cold/indexed-warm latency separately without enforcing 1-2s until parity is green.

happy.desc: full profile reports exact 1,000,000-record reference/indexed/cached parity with required ids and freshness classes matching

edge.desc: latency is reported separately for reference full scan, indexed cold path, and indexed warm/cache path, while SLO remains report-first

adversarial.desc: M6 cannot pass if candidate false-surface, supersession suppression, deprecated-term handling, malformed-row behavior, maxLines, or omittedCount diverges

items.userSees: The million parity command reports recordCount=1000000 plus separate referenceFullScanMs, indexedColdMs, and indexedWarmCacheMs values, while marking performance as report-first.
